title: Harden browser live transcription quality and latency
summary: Reject degenerate Whisper output, preserve truthful silence/errors, and tune bounded browser chunks for responsive live captions without dropping short speech.
acceptanceCriteria: Known repetitive or degenerate hypotheses are rejected as quality failures instead of shown as transcript text.
Legitimate short repetitions remain valid transcript output.
Browser live worker generation stays bounded and cancellation-safe.
No chunk scheduling change silently skips short utterances or causes unbounded queue growth.
npm run check and npm run build pass, plus focused runtime tests pass.
evidence: node --test tests/runtime/asr-quality.test.mjs tests/runtime/live-controller.test.mjs: 7/7 pass (repetitive CJK rejection, legitimate repetition retention, bounded queue, silence, translation disposal).
resultSummary: Browser live transcription now uses bounded 4–8 second chunks, Whisper generation bounds, and conservative output sanitization that rejects repeated hallucinations without inventing replacement text.
